text: いっしょう　のびつづけるので　かたい　モノを　かじって　けずる。

structure.jp: いっしょう　のびつづけるので
structure.en: because they keep growing all its life

structure.jp: かたい　モノを　かじって

patterns.name: 〜つづける
patterns.explanation: つづける on a verb stem means 'keep on doing'. のびつづける = 'keep growing'.

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので after a statement means 'because of that'. のびつづけるので = 'since they keep growing'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て joins onto the next action, here showing how it is done. かじって　けずる = 'wears them down by gnawing'.
